fn rs_require_value(function: *RsFunction, value: *RsValue, expected: *RmdTypeSyntax, location: *RmdLoc) -> bool {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    if (*stage).failed || value == null(*RsValue) { return false; }
    if !rs_same(stage, (*value).syntax, expected) {
        rs_error(stage, location, "source value has an incompatible type or borrow mode");
        return false;
    }
    if (*value).unsafe_call {
        rs_error(stage, location, "unsafe functions can only be called directly");
        return false;
    }
    if rs_owns(stage, expected) && !(*value).owned {
        rs_error(stage, location, "copy of a resource requires an explicit move");
        return false;
    }
    return !(*stage).failed;
}

fn rs_expression_scope(function: *RsFunction, output: *RsStatements, location: *RmdLoc) -> *RmdStmt {
    var block: *RmdStmt = rs_block((*function).stage, output, location);
    if block == null(*RmdStmt) { return block; }
    var continuation: *RsChain = rs_terminal(function);
    if continuation == null(*RsChain) { return null(*RmdStmt); }
    rs_exit(function, block, (*(*function).scope).parent, continuation, continuation);
    rs_leave_scope(function);
    return block;
}

fn rs_transfer(function: *RsFunction, value: *RsValue) -> unit {
    if (*value).owned && (*value).local != null(*RsLocal) { rs_live(function, (*value).local, false); }
}

fn rs_promote_loan(function: *RsFunction, value: *RsValue, scope: *RsScope, location: *RmdLoc) -> unit {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    var source: *RsLocal = (*value).local;
    var parent: *RsLocal = (*source).parent_loan;
    if parent != null(*RsLocal) && !rs_outer(parent, scope) {
        rs_error(stage, location, "borrow would outlive its source storage");
        return;
    }
    var target: *RsLocal = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(RsLocal), alignof(RsLocal)) as *RsLocal;
    if target == null(*RsLocal) { return; }
    *target = *source;
    (*target).name = null(*RmdName);
    (*target).scope = scope;
    (*target).next = (*scope).first;
    (*scope).first = target;
    rs_live(function, source, false);
}

fn rs_call_guard(function: *RsFunction, callee: *RsValue, location: *RmdLoc) -> *RmdStmt {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    var expression: *RmdExpr = (*callee).expression;
    if (*expression).kind == RMD_E_NAME {
        var global: *RsGlobal = rs_global(stage, (*expression).name);
        if global != null(*RsGlobal) && ((*(*global).source).kind == RMD_D_FUNCTION ||
                                        (*(*global).source).kind == RMD_D_EXTERN) {
            return null(*RmdStmt);
        }
    }
    var empty: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_NULL, location);
    var condition: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_BINARY, location);
    var guard: *RmdStmt = rs_stmt_node(stage, RMD_S_IF, location);
    var failure: *RmdStmt = rs_stmt_node(stage, RMD_S_TRAP, location);
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdStmt); }
    (*empty).syntax_type = rs_lower_type(stage, (*callee).syntax);
    (*condition).op = RMD_OP_EQ;
    (*condition).left = rs_clone_expr(stage, expression);
    (*condition).right = empty;
    (*guard).expr = condition;
    var body: RsStatements = make RsStatements { first: failure, last: failure };
    (*guard).body = rs_block(stage, &body, location);
    return guard;
}

fn rs_call(function: *RsFunction, source: *RmdExpr, output: *RsStatements, deferred: *RsScope) -> *RsValue {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    var callee: *RsValue = rs_expr(function, (*source).left, output);
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    var signature: *RmdTypeSyntax = (*callee).syntax;
    if (*signature).kind != RMD_T_FUNCTION {
        rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "call requires a function value");
        return null(*RsValue);
    }
    if (*callee).unsafe_call && (*function).unsafe_depth == 0usize {
        rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "call requires an unsafe region");
        return null(*RsValue);
    }
    if (*source).arg_count != (*signature).param_count {
        rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "wrong number of call arguments");
        return null(*RsValue);
    }
    var result_type: *RmdTypeSyntax = (*signature).base;
    if deferred != null(*RsScope) && (*result_type).kind != RMD_T_UNIT {
        rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "deferred calls must return unit");
        return null(*RsValue);
    }
    var count: usize = (*source).arg_count;
    var values: **RsValue = rs_alloc(stage, count * sizeof(*RsValue), alignof(*RsValue)) as **RsValue;
    var call: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, RMD_E_CALL, &(*source).loc);
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    (*call).left = (*callee).expression;
    (*call).arg_count = count;
    if rs_indirect(result_type) { (*call).arg_count = count + 1usize; }
    (*call).args = rs_alloc(stage, (*call).arg_count * sizeof(*RmdExpr), alignof(*RmdExpr)) as **RmdExpr;
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    var index: usize = 0usize;
    while index < count && !(*stage).failed {
        var value: *RsValue = rs_expr(function, (*source).args[index], output);
        if !rs_require_value(function, value, (*signature).params[index], &(*(*source).args[index]).loc) { return null(*RsValue); }
        if (*value).local == null(*RsLocal) && (*value).mode != RS_READ && (*value).mode != RS_MUT && rs_indirect((*value).syntax) {
            value = rs_capture(function, output, value, &(*source).loc);
            if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
        }
        values[index] = value;
        (*call).args[index] = (*value).expression;
        if rs_indirect((*signature).params[index]) {
            (*call).args[index] = rs_unary(stage, RMD_OP_ADDRESS, (*value).expression, &(*source).loc);
        }
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    var result: *RsValue = null(*RsValue);
    var result_local: *RsLocal = null(*RsLocal);
    if rs_indirect(result_type) {
        result_local = rs_local(function, null(*RmdName), result_type, null(*RmdParam), &(*source).loc);
        if result_local == null(*RsLocal) { return null(*RsValue); }
        (*call).args[count] = rs_unary(stage, RMD_OP_ADDRESS, rs_named(stage, (*result_local).storage, &(*source).loc), &(*source).loc);
    }
    index = 0usize;
    while index < count && !(*stage).failed {
        rs_transfer(function, values[index]);
        if deferred != null(*RsScope) && ((*values[index]).mode == RS_READ || (*values[index]).mode == RS_MUT) {
            rs_promote_loan(function, values[index], deferred, &(*source).loc);
        }
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    var guard: *RmdStmt = rs_call_guard(function, callee, &(*source).loc);
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    if deferred != null(*RsScope) {
        var invoke: *RmdStmt = rs_stmt_node(stage, RMD_S_EXPR, &(*source).loc);
        if invoke == null(*RmdStmt) { return null(*RsValue); }
        (*invoke).expr = call;
        var body: RsStatements = make RsStatements { first: null(*RmdStmt), last: null(*RmdStmt) };
        rs_append(&body, guard);
        rs_append(&body, invoke);
        var statement: *RmdStmt = rs_block(stage, &body, &(*source).loc);
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
        var current: *RsScope = (*function).scope;
        (*function).scope = deferred;
        rs_action(function, null(*RsLocal), statement);
        (*function).scope = current;
        return rs_value(function, result_type, null(*RmdExpr));
    }
    rs_append(output, guard);
    if result_local != null(*RsLocal) || (*result_type).kind == RMD_T_UNIT {
        var invoke: *RmdStmt = rs_stmt_node(stage, RMD_S_EXPR, &(*source).loc);
        if invoke == null(*RmdStmt) { return null(*RsValue); }
        (*invoke).expr = call;
        rs_append(output, invoke);
        result = rs_value(function, result_type, null(*RmdExpr));
        if result_local != null(*RsLocal) && result != null(*RsValue) {
            (*result_local).initialized = true;
            (*result).expression = rs_named(stage, (*result_local).storage, &(*source).loc);
            (*result).local = result_local;
            (*result).owned = (*result_local).owning;
        }
    } else {
        result = rs_capture(function, output, rs_value(function, result_type, call), &(*source).loc);
    }
    index = 0usize;
    while index < count && !(*stage).failed {
        if (*values[index]).mode == RS_READ || (*values[index]).mode == RS_MUT { rs_end_loan(function, (*values[index]).local); }
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    return result;
}

fn rs_short_circuit(function: *RsFunction, source: *RmdExpr, output: *RsStatements) -> *RsValue {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    var bool_type: *RmdTypeSyntax = rs_type_node(stage, RMD_T_BOOL, &(*source).loc);
    var left: *RsValue = rs_expr(function, (*source).left, output);
    if !rs_require_value(function, left, bool_type, &(*source).loc) { return null(*RsValue); }
    var result: *RsValue = rs_capture(function, output, left, &(*source).loc);
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    var marker: *RsChange = (*function).changes;
    var parent: *RsScope = (*function).scope;
    rs_scope(function);
    var body: RsStatements = make RsStatements { first: null(*RmdStmt), last: null(*RmdStmt) };
    var right: *RsValue = rs_expr(function, (*source).right, &body);
    if !rs_require_value(function, right, bool_type, &(*source).loc) { return null(*RsValue); }
    rs_assign(function, &body, rs_named(stage, (*(*result).local).storage, &(*source).loc), (*right).expression, &(*source).loc);
    var block: *RmdStmt = rs_expression_scope(function, &body, &(*source).loc);
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    var changes: *RsChange = rs_snapshot(function, marker, parent);
    rs_restore(function, marker);
    rs_check_snapshot(function, changes, &(*source).loc);
    var conditional: *RmdStmt = rs_stmt_node(stage, RMD_S_IF, &(*source).loc);
    if conditional == null(*RmdStmt) { return null(*RsValue); }
    (*conditional).expr = rs_clone_expr(stage, (*result).expression);
    if (*source).op == RMD_OP_OR {
        (*conditional).expr = rs_unary(stage, RMD_OP_NOT, (*conditional).expr, &(*source).loc);
    }
    (*conditional).body = block;
    rs_append(output, conditional);
    return result;
}

fn rs_make(function: *RsFunction, source: *RmdExpr, output: *RsStatements) -> *RsValue {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    var syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax = (*source).syntax_type;
    var target: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, (*source).kind, &(*source).loc);
    if target == null(*RmdExpr) { return null(*RsValue); }
    (*target).syntax_type = rs_lower_type(stage, syntax);
    var values: **RsValue = null(**RsValue);
    var count: usize = 0usize;
    var global: *RsGlobal = null(*RsGlobal);
    if (*source).kind == RMD_E_RECORD {
        if (*syntax).kind != RMD_T_NAME {
            rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "record construction requires a record type");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        global = rs_global(stage, (*syntax).name);
        if global == null(*RsGlobal) || (*(*global).source).kind != RMD_D_RECORD {
            rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "record construction requires a declared record");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        if (*global).resource != null(*RsResource) && (*function).unsafe_depth == 0usize {
            rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "raw resource construction requires an unsafe region");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        var item: *RmdInit = (*source).inits;
        while item != null(*RmdInit) { count = count + 1usize; item = (*item).next; }
    } else {
        if (*syntax).kind != RMD_T_ARRAY {
            rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "array construction requires an array type");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        count = (*source).arg_count;
        (*target).arg_count = count;
        (*target).args = rs_alloc(stage, count * sizeof(*RmdExpr), alignof(*RmdExpr)) as **RmdExpr;
    }
    values = rs_alloc(stage, count * sizeof(*RsValue), alignof(*RsValue)) as **RsValue;
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    var index: usize = 0usize;
    if (*source).kind == RMD_E_RECORD {
        var item: *RmdInit = (*source).inits;
        var previous: *RmdInit = null(*RmdInit);
        while item != null(*RmdInit) && !(*stage).failed {
            var field: *RmdField = (*(*global).source).fields;
            while field != null(*RmdField) && (*field).name != (*item).name { field = (*field).next; }
            if field == null(*RmdField) {
                rs_error(stage, &(*item).loc, "record has no such field");
                return null(*RsValue);
            }
            var value: *RsValue = rs_expr(function, (*item).value, output);
            if !rs_require_value(function, value, (*field).syntax_type, &(*item).loc) { return null(*RsValue); }
            var copy: *RmdInit = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(RmdInit), alignof(RmdInit)) as *RmdInit;
            if copy == null(*RmdInit) { return null(*RsValue); }
            (*copy).name = (*item).name;
            (*copy).loc = (*item).loc;
            (*copy).value = (*value).expression;
            if previous == null(*RmdInit) { (*target).inits = copy; }
            else { (*previous).next = copy; }
            previous = copy;
            values[index] = value;
            index = index + 1usize;
            item = (*item).next;
        }
    } else {
        while index < count && !(*stage).failed {
            var value: *RsValue = rs_expr(function, (*source).args[index], output);
            if !rs_require_value(function, value, (*syntax).base, &(*source).loc) { return null(*RsValue); }
            values[index] = value;
            (*target).args[index] = (*value).expression;
            index = index + 1usize;
        }
    }
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    var made: *RsValue = rs_value(function, syntax, target);
    if made == null(*RsValue) { return made; }
    (*made).owned = rs_owns(stage, syntax);
    var result: *RsValue = rs_capture(function, output, made, &(*source).loc);
    index = 0usize;
    while index < count && !(*stage).failed { rs_transfer(function, values[index]); index = index + 1usize; }
    return result;
}

fn rs_expr_inner(function: *RsFunction, source: *RmdExpr, output: *RsStatements) -> *RsValue {
    var stage: *RsStage = (*function).stage;
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    var location: *RmdLoc = &(*source).loc;
    var kind: u32 = (*source).kind;
    if kind == RMD_E_GROUP { return rs_expr(function, (*source).left, output); }
    if kind == RMD_E_CALL { return rs_call(function, source, output, null(*RsScope)); }
    if kind == RMD_E_RECORD || kind == RMD_E_ARRAY { return rs_make(function, source, output); }
    if kind == RS_MOVE {
        var operand: *RmdExpr = (*source).left;
        while (*operand).kind == RMD_E_GROUP { operand = (*operand).left; }
        if (*operand).kind != RMD_E_NAME {
            rs_error(stage, location, "move requires a whole local owner");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        var local: *RsLocal = rmd_map_get(&(*function).locals, (*operand).name as usize) as *RsLocal;
        if local == null(*RsLocal) || !(*local).owning || (*local).mode != 0u32 {
            rs_error(stage, location, "move requires a whole local owner");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        rs_access(function, local, true, location);
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
        var value: *RsValue = rs_value(function, (*local).syntax, rs_place_local(function, local, location));
        if value == null(*RsValue) { return value; }
        (*value).owned = true;
        (*value).local = local;
        return rs_capture(function, output, value, location);
    }
    if kind == RS_READ || kind == RS_MUT {
        var place: *RsValue = rs_place(function, (*source).left, output, kind == RS_MUT, false);
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
        if (*place).local != null(*RsLocal) { rs_lend(function, (*place).local, kind, location); }
        else { if (*function).unsafe_depth == 0usize {
            rs_error(stage, location, "borrow has no checked storage owner");
            return null(*RsValue);
        } }
        var syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax = rs_type_node(stage, kind, location);
        if syntax == null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { return null(*RsValue); }
        (*syntax).base = (*place).syntax;
        var local: *RsLocal = rs_local(function, null(*RmdName), syntax, null(*RmdParam), location);
        if local == null(*RsLocal) { return null(*RsValue); }
        (*local).initialized = true;
        (*local).parent_loan = (*place).local;
        rs_assign(function, output, rs_named(stage, (*local).storage, location),
                  rs_unary(stage, RMD_OP_ADDRESS, (*place).expression, location), location);
        var value: *RsValue = rs_value(function, syntax, rs_named(stage, (*local).storage, location));
        if value != null(*RsValue) { (*value).local = local; (*value).mode = kind; }
        return value;
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_NAME {
        var local: *RsLocal = rmd_map_get(&(*function).locals, (*source).name as usize) as *RsLocal;
        if local != null(*RsLocal) {
            rs_access(function, local, false, location);
            if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
            var value: *RsValue = rs_value(function, (*local).syntax, rs_place_local(function, local, location));
            if value == null(*RsValue) { return value; }
            (*value).local = local;
            if rs_owns(stage, (*local).syntax) { return value; }
            return rs_capture(function, output, value, location);
        }
        var global: *RsGlobal = rs_global(stage, (*source).name);
        if global == null(*RsGlobal) || (*(*global).source).kind == RMD_D_RECORD {
            rs_error(stage, location, "unknown value name");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        var value: *RsValue = rs_value(function, (*global).syntax, rs_named(stage, (*source).name, location));
        if value != null(*RsValue) { (*value).unsafe_call = (*global).unsafe_call || (*global).drop_only; }
        return value;
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_FIELD || kind == RMD_E_INDEX || (kind == RMD_E_UNARY && (*source).op == RMD_OP_DEREF) {
        var value: *RsValue = rs_place(function, source, output, false, false);
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
        if rs_owns(stage, (*value).syntax) { return value; }
        (*value).mode = 0u32;
        return rs_capture(function, output, value, location);
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_INTEGER || kind == RMD_E_BOOL || kind == RMD_E_STRING {
        var type_kind: u32 = (*source).literal_type;
        if kind == RMD_E_BOOL { type_kind = RMD_T_BOOL; }
        if kind == RMD_E_STRING { type_kind = RMD_T_U8; }
        var syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax = rs_type_node(stage, type_kind, location);
        if syntax == null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { return null(*RsValue); }
        if kind == RMD_E_STRING { syntax = rs_pointer(stage, syntax); }
        return rs_value(function, syntax, rs_clone_expr(stage, source));
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_NULL {
        var syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax = (*source).syntax_type;
        if (*syntax).kind != RMD_T_POINTER && (*syntax).kind != RMD_T_FUNCTION {
            rs_error(stage, location, "null requires a pointer or function type");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        var expression: *RmdExpr = rs_clone_expr(stage, source);
        if expression == null(*RmdExpr) { return null(*RsValue); }
        (*expression).syntax_type = rs_lower_type(stage, syntax);
        return rs_value(function, syntax, expression);
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_SIZEOF || kind == RMD_E_ALIGNOF || kind == RMD_E_OFFSETOF {
        var expression: *RmdExpr = rs_clone_expr(stage, source);
        if expression == null(*RmdExpr) { return null(*RsValue); }
        (*expression).syntax_type = rs_lower_type(stage, (*source).syntax_type);
        return rs_value(function, rs_type_node(stage, RMD_T_USIZE, location), expression);
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_UNARY && (*source).op == RMD_OP_ADDRESS {
        if (*function).unsafe_depth == 0usize {
            rs_error(stage, location, "raw addresses require an unsafe region; use read or mut for a loan");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        var place: *RsValue = rs_place(function, (*source).left, output, true, true);
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
        var syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax = rs_pointer(stage, (*place).syntax);
        return rs_capture(function, output, rs_value(function, syntax,
            rs_unary(stage, RMD_OP_ADDRESS, (*place).expression, location)), location);
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_BINARY && ((*source).op == RMD_OP_AND || (*source).op == RMD_OP_OR) {
        return rs_short_circuit(function, source, output);
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_UNARY || kind == RMD_E_BINARY || kind == RMD_E_CAST {
        var left: *RsValue = rs_expr(function, (*source).left, output);
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
        if rs_owns(stage, (*left).syntax) || (*left).mode != 0u32 || (*left).unsafe_call {
            rs_error(stage, location, "operation cannot copy or erase a resource or borrowed view");
            return null(*RsValue);
        }
        var result_type: *RmdTypeSyntax = (*left).syntax;
        var expression: *RmdExpr = rs_expr_node(stage, kind, location);
        if expression == null(*RmdExpr) { return null(*RsValue); }
        (*expression).op = (*source).op;
        (*expression).left = (*left).expression;
        if kind == RMD_E_BINARY {
            var right: *RsValue = rs_expr(function, (*source).right, output);
            if (*stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
            if rs_owns(stage, (*right).syntax) || (*right).mode != 0u32 || (*right).unsafe_call {
                rs_error(stage, location, "operation cannot copy or erase a resource or borrowed view");
                return null(*RsValue);
            }
            (*expression).right = (*right).expression;
            if (*source).op >= RMD_OP_EQ && (*source).op <= RMD_OP_OR {
                result_type = rs_type_node(stage, RMD_T_BOOL, location);
            }
            if (*(*left).syntax).kind == RMD_T_POINTER && ((*source).op == RMD_OP_ADD || (*source).op == RMD_OP_SUB) && (*function).unsafe_depth == 0usize {
                rs_error(stage, location, "pointer arithmetic requires an unsafe region");
                return null(*RsValue);
            }
        } else { if kind == RMD_E_CAST {
            result_type = (*source).syntax_type;
            if rs_owns(stage, result_type) || (*result_type).kind == RS_READ || (*result_type).kind == RS_MUT {
                rs_error(stage, location, "casts cannot construct resources or borrowed views");
                return null(*RsValue);
            }
            if ((*result_type).kind == RMD_T_POINTER || (*result_type).kind == RMD_T_FUNCTION ||
                (*(*left).syntax).kind == RMD_T_POINTER || (*(*left).syntax).kind == RMD_T_FUNCTION) && (*function).unsafe_depth == 0usize {
                rs_error(stage, location, "pointer and function casts require an unsafe region");
                return null(*RsValue);
            }
            (*expression).syntax_type = rs_lower_type(stage, result_type);
        } }
        return rs_capture(function, output, rs_value(function, result_type, expression), location);
    }
    rs_error(stage, location, "unsupported source expression");
    return null(*RsValue);
}

fn rs_expr(function: *RsFunction, source: *RmdExpr, output: *RsStatements) -> *RsValue {
    if (*(*function).stage).failed { return null(*RsValue); }
    if (*function).expression_depth >= 256u32 {
        rs_error((*function).stage, &(*source).loc, "expression nesting exceeds resource stage limit");
        return null(*RsValue);
    }
    (*function).expression_depth = (*function).expression_depth + 1u32;
    var value: *RsValue = rs_expr_inner(function, source, output);
    (*function).expression_depth = (*function).expression_depth - 1u32;
    return value;
}
